name: @acfatah/memory-cache
description: A simple in-memory cache for bun and nodejs.

scripts.build: bun --version > .bun-version && bun install && bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.lint:changed: { git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=d --relative HEAD; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- ':./'; } | xargs -0 -r bunx --bun oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.lint:staged: staged_files=$(git diff --relative --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d); [ -z "$staged_files" ] || { bunx --bun oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern $staged_files && bunx --bun oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --check $staged_files; }
scripts.format:changed: { git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=d --relative HEAD; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- ':./'; } | xargs -0 -r sh -c 'bunx --bun oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --fix "$@" && bunx --bun oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$@"' _
scripts.format:staged: staged_files=$(git diff --relative --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d); [ -z "$staged_files" ] || { bunx --bun oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --fix $staged_files && bunx --bun oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern $staged_files && git add $staged_files; }
scripts.precommit: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:staged
